name: Sympac
summary: Gippsland dialup ISP + retail software business (Sym-Pac Computing Pty Ltd, ACN 053 433 766, founded 1991 Warragul; 'Powered by Connect'/connect.com.au; 2,000+ ISP clients in Gippsland); AAV agreed to acquire all shares Apr 2000; renamed Sympac Solutions Pty Ltd 2007; continues as retail/POS software under Constellation Software/Vela APX.

events.details: Sym-Pac Computing founded in Warragul VIC.
